big: On 1 January 2026, SEBI changed how mutual funds and SIFs treat REITs: as equity-related instruments. InvITs stay hybrid. A client may now see REIT units sitting inside an equity fund's holdings.

lines: Debt schemes that held REIT units on 31 December 2025 may keep them, and AMCs are encouraged, not forced, to reduce them over time. REITs can enter equity indices after a six-month buffer, from July 2026. Read the holdings table and the scheme addendum, because factsheets may now show REIT or InvIT units in equity or hybrid holdings.
